measure.Description: the measure: ReHo, fALFF (raw ROI means; primary), their within-brain z-scored versions (sensitivity), and per-animal summaries of the Fisher-z connectivity matrix with / without global signal regression

Levels.GM_L: mean over the left grey-matter ROIs
Levels.GM_R: mean over the right grey-matter ROIs
Levels.FC_mean: mean connectivity over all grey-matter edges
Levels.FC_left: mean connectivity within the left hemisphere
Levels.FC_right: mean connectivity within the right hemisphere
Levels.FC_homotopic: mean connectivity over left-right homologue pairs

Levels.change_group: the group difference in within-animal change
Levels.cross: the group difference at one timepoint (diagnostic)

level.Description: the window (change tests) or the timepoint (cross)

observed_direction.Description: the direction the contrast estimate went

group_a.Description: two-group tests: the group higher when the statistic is positive

df.Description: error degrees of freedom of the cohort model

estimate.Description: the contrast estimate in the measure's own units: mean within-animal change, or cuprizone minus control

ci95_low.Description: lower bound of the estimate's 95% bootstrap interval

ci95_high.Description: upper bound of the estimate's 95% bootstrap interval

se.Description: standard error of the estimate (cohort model)

p.Description: p of the contrast from the cohort model's t, uncorrected

d.Description: Cohen's d, pooled SD, on per-animal values, ignoring cohort (no interval recorded)

mean_cuprizone.Description: mean of the cuprizone animals (empty where the test has none)

mean_control.Description: mean of the control animals (empty where the test has none)

d_X.Description: d in cuprizone cohort X against all controls

d_Y.Description: d in cuprizone cohort Y against all controls

d_Z.Description: d in cuprizone cohort Z against all controls

adj_estimate.Description: change-group tests: the estimate adjusted for each animal's baseline (change ~ cohort + baseline)
